description: Discover which ATProtocol permission-set lexicon schemas cover a given set of collections and/or XRPC methods. Returns matching permission sets with their OAuth scope strings (`include:<nsid>`), useful for determining what OAuth scopes an application needs.

collections.description: List of collection NSIDs your application reads or writes (e.g., ['app.bsky.feed.post', 'app.bsky.actor.profile', 'garden.lexicon.example'])

methods.description: Optional: List of XRPC method NSIDs your application calls (e.g., ['app.bsky.video.uploadVideo', 'com.atproto.repo.listRecords'])

name: discover_permission_sets
